component.name: ApiTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return
http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(url) http.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.InitClientCertificates() http.AddHeader("Accept", "application/json") http.AddHeader("User-Agent", "MasterChief-Roku/1.0")
resp = http.GetToString() code = http.GetResponseCode()
if code >= 200 and code < 300 parsed = ParseJSON(resp) if parsed <> invalid m.top.result = parsed else m.top.result = {error: "JSON parse failed", raw: Left(resp, 200)} end if else m.top.result = {error: "HTTP " + str(code)} end if end sub
